# SEOGlint

> SEOGlint is a free SEO, GEO, AEO, AIO and SXO audit tool. Paste a page's HTML or enter a URL, and it scans for classic SEO, technical health, and AI-search readiness — returning a 0–100 score, per-check evidence, and ready-to-paste fixes.

## Core
- [SEOGlint home](https://searchlens-five.vercel.app/): the audit tool — scan any page for SEO, technical, and GEO/AEO readiness.

## What it checks
- On-Page SEO: title, meta description, headings, image alt text, canonical, Open Graph, mobile viewport, language.
- Technical & schema: JSON-LD structured data, Organization/entity markup, and whether core content lives in the raw HTML.
- GEO / AEO / AIO (AI Optimization): AI-crawler access (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, etc.), llms.txt, answer-first content, question-style headings, extractable content, FAQ schema, and freshness signals.

## Blog
- [SEOGlint Blog](https://searchlens-five.vercel.app/blog.html): weekly SEO, GEO and AEO tips and guides.
- [Google AI Search 2026: 9 Ways to Rank in AI Overviews](https://searchlens-five.vercel.app/blog/google-ai-search-2026-how-to-rank.html): how to get your website cited in Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, and generative search results.
- [How to Get Cited by AI Search Engines](https://searchlens-five.vercel.app/blog/how-to-get-cited-by-ai-search-engines.html): 7 actionable fixes to get your site cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini.

## About
- Free to use. The audit runs in the browser; live URL scanning uses a lightweight serverless backend.
- Topics: SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), AIO (AI Optimization), AI search visibility, llms.txt, structured data.
